ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity dominance; approximately 95:5 ratio of black/dark-grey pixels to high-intensity white pixel highlights from localized scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity distribution across the central and proximal surface area, with distinct high-intensity circular coordinates (rings) mapped primarily to the distal regions of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending ~12% into the fluke midsection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the full trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 5-20 pixels, with significant jaggedness near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge sweep with a sharp angular transition at the distal tips; trailing edge follows a jagged linear trajectory towards the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized detection of multiple circular and annular high-contrast pixel clusters; 5 distinct rings on the far-left lobe tip and 4 distinct rings on the upper-right distal quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular barnacle attachment scars and secondary annular scarring; significant jagged erosion and irregular pixel variance on the distal margins of the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, almost shredded appearance of the extreme distal tip of the left lobe compared to the more continuous right lobe tip.
